name: Native Swap
description: Native Swap enables PMM pricing and atomic Swaps with on-chain credit management. Native introduces a high-frequency, auto-sign orderbook that seamlessly aligns with prevailing market prices, offering reliable quotes to ensure low latency and a high success rate by utilizing real-time on-chain inventory.
methodology: Counts the inventory held by Native's Partnered Market Makers used to facilitate slippage free swaps on the protocol
